```typescript
// functions/firestore.ts

interface ServiceAccount {
  type: string;
  project_id: string;
  private_key: string;
  client_email: string;
  token_uri: string;
}

export class FirestoreClient {
  private sa: ServiceAccount;
  private projectId: string;
  private cachedToken: { token: string; expiresAt: number } | null = null;

  constructor(serviceAccountKey: string) {
    this.sa = JSON.parse(serviceAccountKey);
    this.projectId = this.sa.project_id;
  }

  private async getAccessToken(): Promise<string> {
    if (this.cachedToken && Date.now() < this.cachedToken.expiresAt - 60000) {
      return this.cachedToken.token;
    }
    // Create JWT
    const header = { alg: "RS256", typ: "JWT" };
    const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    const payload = {
      iss: this.sa.client_email,
      scope: "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/datastore",
      aud: "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
      iat: now,
      exp: now + 3600,
    };
    const jwt = await this.signJwt(header, payload);
    // Exchange JWT for access token
    const resp = await fetch("https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
      body: `grant_type=urn%3Aietf%3Aparams%3Aoauth%3Agrant-type%3Ajwt-bearer&assertion=${jwt}`,
    });
    const data = await resp.json();
    this.cachedToken = {
      token: data.access_token,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + data.expires_in * 1000,
    };
    return this.cachedToken.token;
  }

  private async signJwt(header: any, payload: any): Promise<string> {
    const enc = (obj: any) => btoa(JSON.stringify(obj)).replace(/=/g, "").replace(/\+/g, "-").replace(/\//g, "_");
    const headerB64 = enc(header);
    const payloadB64 = enc(payload);
    const data = `${headerB64}.${payloadB64}`;
    
    // Import private key
    const pemKey = this.sa.private_key.replace(/-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----/, "").replace(/-----END PRIVATE KEY-----/, "").replace(/\n/g, "").replace(/\r/g, "");
    const keyBytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(pemKey), c => c.charCodeAt(0));
    
    const cryptoKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
      "pkcs8",
      keyBytes,
      { name: "RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5", hash: "SHA-256" },
      false,
      ["sign"]
    );
    
    const signature = await crypto.subtle.sign(
      "RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5",
      cryptoKey,
      new TextEncoder().encode(data)
    );
    
    const sigB64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(signature))).replace(/=/g, "").replace(/\+/g, "-").replace(/\//g, "_");
    return `${data}.${sigB64}`;
  }

  private get baseUrl(): string {
    return `https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${this.projectId}/databases/(default)/documents`;
  }

  private async request(method: string, path: string, body?: any): Promise<any> {
    const token = await this.getAccessToken();
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
      "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    };
    const resp = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/${path}`, {
      method,
      headers,
      body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
    });
    if (resp.status === 404) return null;
    if (!resp.ok) {
      const err = await resp.text();
      throw new Error(`Firestore error: ${resp.status} ${err}`);
    }
    if (resp.status === 200) return resp.json();
    return null;
  }

  // Convert JS value to Firestore field
  private toField(value: any): any {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) return { nullValue: null };
    if (typeof value === "string") return { stringValue: value };
    if (typeof value === "boolean") return { booleanValue: value };
    if (typeof value === "number") {
      if (Number.isInteger(value)) return { integerValue: String(value) };
      return { doubleValue: value };
    }
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      return { arrayValue: { values: value.map(v => this.toField(v)) } };
    }
    if (typeof value === "object") {
      const fields: Record<string, any> = {};
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(value)) {
        fields[k] = this.toField(v);
      }
      return { mapValue: { fields } };
    }
    return { nullValue: null };
  }

  // Convert Firestore field to JS value
  private fromField(field: any): any {
    if (field.nullValue !== undefined) return null;
    if (field.stringValue !== undefined) return field.stringValue;
    if (field.booleanValue !== undefined) return field.booleanValue;
    if (field.integerValue !== undefined) return parseInt(field.integerValue);
    if (field.doubleValue !== undefined) return field.doubleValue;
    if (field.timestampValue !== undefined) return field.timestampValue;
    if (field.arrayValue) {
      return (field.arrayValue.values || []).map((v: any) => this.fromField(v));
    }
    if (field.mapValue) {
      const result: Record<string, any> = {};
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(field.mapValue.fields || {})) {
        result[k] = this.fromField(v);
      }
      return result;
    }
    return null;
  }

  // Convert Firestore document to JS object
  docToObject(doc: any): Record<string, any> {
    if (!doc.fields) return {};
    const result: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(doc.fields)) {
      result[k] = this.fromField(v);
    }
    result._id = doc.name?.split("/").pop() || "";
    return result;
  }

  // Convert JS object to Firestore document
  objectToDoc(obj: Record<string, any>): { fields: Record<string, any> } {
    const fields: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
      if (v !== undefined) {
        fields[k] = this.toField(v);
      }
    }
    return { fields };
  }

  // CRUD operations
  async getDoc(collection: string, docId: string): Promise<Record<string, any> | null> {
    const doc = await this.request("GET", `${collection}/${docId}`);
    if (!doc) return null;
    return this.docToObject(doc);
  }

  async setDoc(collection: string, docId: string, data: Record<string, any>, merge: boolean = false): Promise<void> {
    const path = merge 
      ? `${collection}/${docId}?updateMask.fieldPaths=${Object.keys(data).join("&updateMask.fieldPaths=")}`
      : `${collection}/${docId}`;
    await this.request(merge ? "PATCH" : "PUT", path, this.objectToDoc(data));
  }

  async createDoc(collection: string, data: Record<string, any>): Promise<Record<string, any>> {
    const doc = await this.request("POST", collection, this.objectToDoc(data));
    return this.docToObject(doc);
  }

  async deleteDoc(collection: string, docId: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.request("DELETE", `${collection}/${docId}`);
  }

        compositeFilter: {
          op: "AND",
          filters: filters.map(f => ({
            fieldFilter: {
              field: { fieldPath: f.field },
              op: f.op,
              value: this.toField(f.value),
            },
          })),
        },
      },
    };

    const token = await this.getAccessToken();
    const resp = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}:runQuery`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ structuredQuery }),
    });
    const results = await resp.json();
    return results
      .filter((r: any) => r.document)
      .map((r: any) => this.docToObject(r.document));
  }

      from: [{ collectionId: collection, allDescendants: true }],
      where: {
        compositeFilter: {
          op: "AND",
          filters: filters.map(f => ({
            fieldFilter: {
              field: { fieldPath: f.field },
              op: f.op,
              value: this.toField(f.value),
            },
          })),
        },
      },
    };

    const token = await this.getAccessToken();
    const resp = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}:runQuery`, {

  }

  async countDocs(collection: string, filters: { field: string; op: string; value: any }[] = []): Promise<number> {
    const structuredQuery: any = {
      from: [{ collectionId: collection }],
      aggregations: [{
        aggregation: { count: {} },
      }],
    };
    if (filters.length > 0) {
      structuredQuery.where = {
        compositeFilter: {
          op: "AND",
          filters: filters.map(f => ({
            fieldFilter: {
              field: { fieldPath: f.field },
              op: f.op,
              value: this.toField(f.value),
            },
          })),
        },
      };
    }
    
    const token = await this.getAccessToken();
    const resp = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}:runAggregationQuery`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ structuredAggregationQuery: { structuredQuery } }),
    });
    const results = await resp.json();
    const countResult = results.find((r: any) => r.result?.aggregateFields?.count);
    return countResult ? parseInt(countResult.result.aggregateFields.count.integerValue) : 0;
  }

    // Firestore batch write is limited to 20 operations
    const token = await this.getAccessToken();
    const batch: any = { writes: operations };
    const resp = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl.replace('/documents', '')}:batchWrite`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(batch),
    });
```

```typescript
// functions/firestore-client.ts

interface ServiceAccount {
  type: string;
  project_id: string;
  private_key: string;
  client_email: string;
  token_uri: string;
}

let cachedAccount: ServiceAccount | null = null;
let cachedToken: { token: string; expiresAt: number } | null = null;

function parseServiceAccount(json: string): ServiceAccount {
  const data = JSON.parse(json);
  return {
    type: data.type,
    project_id: data.project_id,
    private_key: data.private_key,
    client_email: data.client_email,
    token_uri: data.token_uri || "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
  };
}

function getAccount(key: string): ServiceAccount {
  if (!cachedAccount) {
    cachedAccount = parseServiceAccount(key);
  }
  return cachedAccount;
}

// Base64url encode
function b64url(buffer: ArrayBuffer): string {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
  let binary = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
  }
  return btoa(binary).replace(/\+/g, "-").replace(/\//g, "_").replace(/=+$/, "");
}

// Import private key and sign JWT
async function getAccessToken(account: ServiceAccount): Promise<string> {
  if (cachedToken && cachedToken.expiresAt > Date.now() + 60000) {
    return cachedToken.token;
  }

  // Parse PEM private key
  const pemBody = account.private_key
    .replace(/-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----/, "")
    .replace(/-----END PRIVATE KEY-----/, "")
    .replace(/\s/g, "");
  const binaryDer = atob(pemBody);
  const derBytes = new Uint8Array(binaryDer.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < binaryDer.length; i++) {
    derBytes[i] = binaryDer.charCodeAt(i);
  }

  // Import key
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "pkcs8",
    derBytes.buffer,
    { name: "RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5", hash: "SHA-256" },
    false,
    ["sign"]
  );

  // Create JWT
  const header = { alg: "RS256", typ: "JWT" };
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const payload = {
    iss: account.client_email,
    scope: "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/datastore https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform",
    aud: account.token_uri,
    iat: now,
    exp: now + 3600,
  };

  const headerB64 = b64url(new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(header)).buffer as ArrayBuffer);
  const payloadB64 = b64url(new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(payload)).buffer as ArrayBuffer);
  const message = `${headerB64}.${payloadB64}`;

  const signature = await crypto.subtle.sign(
    "RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5",
    key,
    new TextEncoder().encode(message)
  );

  const jwt = `${message}.${b64url(signature)}`;

  // Exchange JWT for access token
  const response = await fetch(account.token_uri, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body: `grant_type=urn%3Aietf%3Aparams%3Aoauth%3Agrant-type%3Ajwt-bearer&assertion=${jwt}`,
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    const text = await response.text();
    throw new Error(`Failed to get access token: ${response.status} ${text}`);
  }

  const data = await response.json();
  cachedToken = {
    token: data.access_token,
    expiresAt: Date.now() + (data.expires_in - 60) * 1000,
  };
  return cachedToken.token;
}

// Firestore REST API base
function fsBase(projectId: string): string {
  return `https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${projectId}/databases/(default)/documents`;
}

// Convert JS value to Firestore field value
function toFieldValue(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) {
    return { nullValue: null };
  }
  if (typeof value === "string") {
    return { stringValue: value };
  }
  if (typeof value === "number") {
    if (Number.isInteger(value)) {
      return { integerValue: String(value) };
    }
    return { doubleValue: value };
  }
  if (typeof value === "boolean") {
    return { booleanValue: value };
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return {
      arrayValue: {
        values: value.map((v) => toFieldValue(v)),
      },
    };
  }
  if (typeof value === "object") {
    const fields: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(value)) {
      fields[k] = toFieldValue(v);
    }
    return { mapValue: { fields } };
  }
  return { nullValue: null };
}

// Convert Firestore field value to JS value
function fromFieldValue(field: Record<string, unknown>): unknown {
  if ("nullValue" in field) return null;
  if ("stringValue" in field) return field.stringValue;
  if ("integerValue" in field) return parseInt(field.integerValue as string, 10);
  if ("doubleValue" in field) return field.doubleValue;
  if ("booleanValue" in field) return field.booleanValue;
  if ("arrayValue" in field) {
    const arr = (field.arrayValue as { values: unknown[] }).values;
    return arr.map(fromFieldValue);
  }
  if ("mapValue" in field) {
    const fields = (field.mapValue as { fields: Record<string, unknown> }).fields;
    const obj: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(fields)) {
      obj[k] = fromFieldValue(v);
    }
    return obj;
  }
  if ("timestampValue" in field) return field.timestampValue;
  return null;
}

// Convert JS object to Firestore document
function toFirestoreDoc(obj: Record<string, unknown>): { fields: Record<string, unknown> } {
  const fields: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    fields[k] = toFieldValue(v);
  }
  return { fields };
}

// Convert Firestore document to JS object
function fromFirestoreDoc(doc: any): Record<string, unknown> {
  const fields = doc.fields || {};
  const obj: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(fields)) {
    obj[k] = fromFieldValue(v as Record<string, unknown>);
  }
  obj["_id"] = doc.name?.split("/").pop();
  return obj;
}

      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Firestore PATCH failed: ${resp.status} ${await resp.text()}`);
  }

  async delete(collection: string, docId: string): Promise<void> {
    const headers = await this.authHeaders();
    const resp = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/${collection}/${docId}`, {
      method: "DELETE",
      headers,
    });
    if (!resp.ok && resp.status !== 404) throw new Error(`Firestore DELETE failed: ${resp.status}`);
  }

  async list(collection: string, options?: { pageSize?: number; pageToken?: string; orderBy?: string }): Promise<Record<string, unknown>[]> {
    const headers = await this.authHeaders();
    let url = `${this.baseUrl}/${collection}`;
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (options?.pageSize) params.set("pageSize", String(options.pageSize));
    if (options?.pageToken) params.set("pageToken", options.pageToken);
    if (options?.orderBy) params.set("orderBy", options.orderBy);
    const qs = params.toString();
    if (qs) url += `?${qs}`;
    
    const resp = await fetch(url, { headers });
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Firestore LIST failed: ${resp.status}`);
    const data = await resp.json();
    const docs = data.documents || [];
    return docs.map(fromFirestoreDoc);
  }

  async query(
    collection: string,
    filters: Array<{ field: string; op: string; value: unknown }>,
    options?: { orderBy?: string; limit?: number; direction?: "ASCENDING" | "DESCENDING" }
  ): Promise<Record<string, unknown>[]> {
    const headers = await this.authHeaders();
    const structuredQuery: any = {
      from: [{ collectionId: collection }],
    };

    if (filters.length > 0) {
      if (filters.length === 1) {
        structuredQuery.where = {
          fieldFilter: {
            field: { fieldPath: filters[0].field },
            op: filters[0].op,
            value: toFieldValue(filters[0].value),
          },
        };
      } else {
        structuredQuery.where = {
          compositeFilter: {
            op: "AND",
            filters: filters.map((f) => ({
              fieldFilter: {
                field: { fieldPath: f.field },
                op: f.op,
                value: toFieldValue(f.value),
              },
            })),
          },
        };
      }
    }

    if (options?.orderBy) {
      structuredQuery.orderBy = [{
        field: { fieldPath: options.orderBy },
        direction: options.direction || "ASCENDING",
      }];
    }

    if (options?.limit) {
      structuredQuery.limit = options.limit;
    }

    const resp = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/${collection}:runQuery`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers,
      body: JSON.stringify({ structuredQuery }),
    });

    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Firestore QUERY failed: ${resp.status} ${await resp.text()}`);
    const data = await resp.json();
    // runQuery returns an array of objects with "document" field
    return data
      .filter((item: any) => item.document)
      .map((item: any) => fromFirestoreDoc(item.document));
  }

  async count(collection: string, filters?: Array<{ field: string; op: string; value: unknown }>): Promise<number> {
    // Use runAggregationQuery for COUNT
    const headers = await this.authHeaders();
    const structuredQuery: any = {
      from: [{ collectionId: collection }],
    };

    if (filters && filters.length > 0) {
      if (filters.length === 1) {
        structuredQuery.where = {
          fieldFilter: {
            field: { fieldPath: filters[0].field },
            op: filters[0].op,
            value: toFieldValue(filters[0].value),
          },
        };
      } else {
        structuredQuery.where = {
          compositeFilter: {
            op: "AND",
            filters: filters.map((f) => ({
              fieldFilter: {
                field: { fieldPath: f.field },
                op: f.op,
                value: toFieldValue(f.value),
              },
            })),
          },
        };
      }
    }

    const body = {
      structuredAggregationQuery: {
        aggregations: [{ count: {} }],
        structuredQuery,
      },
    };

    const resp = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/${collection}:runAggregationQuery`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers,
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });

    if (!resp.ok) {
      // Fallback: just list and count
      const docs = await this.list(collection, { pageSize: 1000 });
      return docs.length;
    }
    const data = await resp.json();
    // The response contains a result with count
    const result = data[0]?.result;
    if (result?.aggregateValue?.integerValue) {
      return parseInt(result.aggregateValue.integerValue, 10);
    }
    if (result?.count?.integerValue) {
      return parseInt(result.count.integerValue, 10);
    }
    return 0;
  }

  async batchWrite(writes: Array<{ collection: string; docId: string; data: Record<string, unknown> }>): Promise<void> {
    const headers = await this.authHeaders();
    const batchUrl = `https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${this.account.project_id}/databases/(default)/documents:batchWrite`;
    
    const writesPayload = writes.map((w) => ({
      update: {
        name: `${this.baseUrl}/${w.collection}/${w.docId}`,
        ...toFirestoreDoc(w.data),
      },
    }));

    // Process in chunks of 20 (Firestore batch limit)
    for (let i = 0; i < writesPayload.length; i += 20) {
      const chunk = writesPayload.slice(i, i + 20);
      const resp = await fetch(batchUrl, {
        method: "POST",
        headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({ writes: chunk }),
      });
      if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Firestore batchWrite failed: ${resp.status} ${await resp.text()}`);
    }
  }
}
```

For importing the PEM private key into Web Crypto:
```javascript
// PEM key format: "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\n...\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----"
// Need to convert to DER format, then importKey

async function importRsaKey(pem: string): Promise<CryptoKey> {
  const pemContents = pem.replace(/-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----/, '').replace(/-----END PRIVATE KEY-----/, '').replace(/\n/g, '');
  const derBuffer = base64ToArrayBuffer(pemContents);
  return crypto.subtle.importKey(
    'pkcs8',
    derBuffer,
    { name: 'RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5', hash: 'SHA-256' },
    false,
    ['sign']
  );
}
```

```typescript
// Firestore REST API client for Cloudflare Workers

interface ServiceAccount {
  private_key: string;
  client_email: string;
  project_id: string;
}

let cachedToken: { token: string; expiresAt: number } | null = null;

async function getAccessToken(serviceAccount: ServiceAccount): Promise<string> {
  if (cachedToken && cachedToken.expiresAt > Date.now() + 60000) {
    return cachedToken.token;
  }
  
  // Create JWT
  const header = { alg: "RS256", typ: "JWT" };
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const payload = {
    iss: serviceAccount.client_email,
    scope: "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/datastore",
    aud: "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
    iat: now,
    exp: now + 3600,
  };
  
  const encodedHeader = base64UrlEncode(JSON.stringify(header));
  const encodedPayload = base64UrlEncode(JSON.stringify(payload));
  const signingInput = `${encodedHeader}.${encodedPayload}`;
  
  // Import private key
  const keyData = pemToDer(serviceAccount.private_key);
  const cryptoKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "pkcs8",
    keyData,
    { name: "RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5", hash: "SHA-256" },
    false,
    ["sign"]
  );
  
  // Sign
  const signature = await crypto.subtle.sign(
    "RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5",
    cryptoKey,
    new TextEncoder().encode(signingInput)
  );
  
  const encodedSignature = base64UrlEncode(new Uint8Array(signature));
  const jwt = `${signingInput}.${encodedSignature}`;
  
  // Exchange for access token
  const resp = await fetch("https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body: `grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer&assertion=${jwt}`,
  });
  
  const data = await resp.json();
  cachedToken = {
    token: data.access_token,
    expiresAt: Date.now() + (data.expires_in - 60) * 1000,
  };
  return cachedToken.token;
}

function pemToDer(pem: string): ArrayBuffer {
  const b64 = pem
    .replace("-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----", "")
    .replace("-----END PRIVATE KEY-----", "")
    .replace(/\n/g, "")
    .replace(/\r/g, "")
    .trim();
  const binary = atob(b64);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
    bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
  }
  return bytes.buffer;
}

function base64UrlEncode(input: string | Uint8Array): string {
  let bytes: Uint8Array;
  if (typeof input === "string") {
    bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(input);
  } else {
    bytes = input;
  }
  const b64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...bytes));
  return b64.replace(/\+/g, "-").replace(/\//g, "_").replace(/=+$/, "");
}
```

```typescript
export class Firestore {
  private projectId: string;
  private serviceAccount: ServiceAccount;
  private baseUrl: string;
  
  constructor(serviceAccountJson: string) {
    this.serviceAccount = JSON.parse(serviceAccountJson);
    this.projectId = this.serviceAccount.project_id;
    this.baseUrl = `https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${this.projectId}/databases/(default)/documents`;
  }
  
  private async headers(): Promise<HeadersInit> {
    const token = await getAccessToken(this.serviceAccount);
    return {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    };
  }
  
  async getDoc(collection: string, docId: string): Promise<Record<string, any> | null> {
    const resp = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/${collection}/${docId}`, {
      headers: await this.headers(),
    });
    if (resp.status === 404) return null;
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Firestore getDoc failed: ${resp.status}`);
    const data = await resp.json();
    return { id: docId, ...fromFirestoreFields(data.fields) };
  }
  
  async setDoc(collection: string, docId: string, data: Record<string, any>, merge: boolean = false): Promise<void> {
    const url = new URL(`${this.baseUrl}/${collection}/${docId}`);
    if (merge) {
      // Add field mask for merge
      Object.keys(data).forEach(key => {
        url.searchParams.append("updateMask.fieldPaths", key);
      });
    }
    const resp = await fetch(url.toString(), {
      method: "PATCH",
      headers: await this.headers(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ fields: toFirestoreFields(data) }),
    });
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Firestore setDoc failed: ${resp.status}`);
  }
  
  async deleteDoc(collection: string, docId: string): Promise<void> {
    const resp = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/${collection}/${docId}`, {
      method: "DELETE",
      headers: await this.headers(),
    });
    if (!resp.ok && resp.status !== 404) throw new Error(`Firestore deleteDoc failed: ${resp.status}`);
  }
  
  async listDocs(collection: string, options?: { pageSize?: number, filter?: string }): Promise<Record<string, any>[]> {
    const url = new URL(`${this.baseUrl}/${collection}`);
    if (options?.pageSize) url.searchParams.set("pageSize", String(options.pageSize));
    const resp = await fetch(url.toString(), {
      headers: await this.headers(),
    });
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Firestore listDocs failed: ${resp.status}`);
    const data = await resp.json();
    return (data.documents || []).map((doc: any) => ({
      id: doc.name.split("/").pop(),
      ...fromFirestoreFields(doc.fields),
    }));
  }
  
  async query(collection: string, filters: Array<{field: string, op: string, value: any}>, limit?: number): Promise<Record<string, any>[]> {
    const body: any = {
      structuredQuery: {
        from: [{ collectionId: collection }],
        where: buildFilter(filters),
      },
    };
    if (limit) body.structuredQuery.limit = limit;
    
    const resp = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/${collection}:runQuery`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: await this.headers(),
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Firestore query failed: ${resp.status}`);
    const data = await resp.json();
    return (data || [])
      .filter((item: any) => item.document)
      .map((item: any) => ({
        id: item.document.name.split("/").pop(),
        ...fromFirestoreFields(item.document.fields),
      }));
  }
  
  async batchWrite(writes: Array<{update?: {collection: string, docId: string, data: Record<string,any>}, delete?: {collection: string, docId: string}}>): Promise<void> {
    const body = {
      writes: writes.map(w => {
        if (w.update) {
          return {
            update: {
              name: `${this.baseUrl}/${w.update.collection}/${w.update.docId}`,
              fields: toFirestoreFields(w.update.data),
            },
          };
        } else if (w.delete) {
          return {
            delete: `${this.baseUrl}/${w.delete.collection}/${w.delete.docId}`,
          };
        }
        return null;
      }).filter(Boolean),
    };
    
    const resp = await fetch(`https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${this.projectId}/databases/(default)/documents:batchWrite`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: await this.headers(),
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Firestore batchWrite failed: ${resp.status}`);
  }
  
  async commit(writes: Array<{update?: ..., delete?: ...}>): Promise<void> {
    // Similar to batchWrite but uses commit endpoint
  }
}
```

And the field conversion functions:

```typescript
function toFirestoreFields(obj: Record<string, any>): Record<string, any> {
  const fields: Record<string, any> = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    fields[key] = toFieldValue(value);
  }
  return fields;
}

function toFieldValue(value: any): any {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) {
    return { nullValue: null };
  }
  if (typeof value === "string") {
    return { stringValue: value };
  }
  if (typeof value === "number") {
    if (Number.isInteger(value)) {
      return { integerValue: String(value) };
    }
    return { doubleValue: value };
  }
  if (typeof value === "boolean") {
    return { booleanValue: value };
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return {
      arrayValue: {
        values: value.map(v => toFieldValue(v)),
      },
    };
  }
  if (typeof value === "object") {
    return {
      mapValue: {
        fields: toFirestoreFields(value),
      },
    };
  }
  return { nullValue: null };
}

function fromFirestoreFields(fields: Record<string, any>): Record<string, any> {
  const result: Record<string, any> = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(fields)) {
    result[key] = fromFieldValue(value);
  }
  return result;
}

function fromFieldValue(value: any): any {
  if (value.nullValue !== undefined) return null;
  if (value.stringValue !== undefined) return value.stringValue;
  if (value.integerValue !== undefined) return parseInt(value.integerValue);
  if (value.doubleValue !== undefined) return value.doubleValue;
  if (value.booleanValue !== undefined) return value.booleanValue;
  if (value.arrayValue !== undefined) {
    return (value.arrayValue.values || []).map(fromFieldValue);
  }
  if (value.mapValue !== undefined) {
    return fromFirestoreFields(value.mapValue.fields || {});
  }
  if (value.timestampValue !== undefined) return value.timestampValue;
  return null;
}
```

```typescript
function buildFilter(filters: Array<{field: string, op: string, value: any}>): any {
  if (filters.length === 0) return {};
  if (filters.length === 1) {
    return {
      fieldFilter: {
        field: { fieldPath: filters[0].field },
        op: filters[0].op,
        value: toFieldValue(filters[0].value),
      },
    };
  }
  return {
    compositeFilter: {
      op: "AND",
      filters: filters.map(f => ({
        fieldFilter: {
          field: { fieldPath: f.field },
          op: f.op,
          value: toFieldValue(f.value),
        },
      })),
    },
  };
}
```

For the Firestore REST API:
- Base URL: `https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/{project_id}/databases/(default)/documents`
- Auth: Bearer token from service account JWT
- Create/replace document: POST or PATCH to `/{collection}/{documentId}`
- Get document: GET `/{collection}/{documentId}`
- Delete document: DELETE `/{collection}/{documentId}`
- Query: POST `/{collection}:runQuery`

The service account JSON has:
- `client_email` - the service account email
- `private_key` - RSA private key
- `project_id` - the Firebase project ID

To get an OAuth2 access token:
1. Create a JWT with header `{"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT"}` and payload `{"iss": client_email, "scope": "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/datastore", "aud": "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", "exp": ..., "iat": ...}`
2. Sign with the private key using RS256
3. Exchange the JWT for an access token at `https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token`

Here's my plan for the firestore.ts module:

```typescript
// Firestore REST API client for Cloudflare Workers

interface ServiceAccount {
  type: string;
  project_id: string;
  private_key: string;
  client_email: string;
  client_id: string;
  auth_uri: string;
  token_uri: string;
  auth_provider_x509_cert_url: string;
  client_x509_cert_url: string;
}

let cachedToken: { token: string; expiresAt: number } | null = null;

async function getAccessToken(serviceAccount: ServiceAccount): Promise<string> {
  if (cachedToken && cachedToken.expiresAt > Date.now() + 60000) {
    return cachedToken.token;
  }
  
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const header = { alg: "RS256", typ: "JWT" };
  const payload = {
    iss: serviceAccount.client_email,
    scope: "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/datastore",
    aud: "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
    exp: now + 3600,
    iat: now,
  };
  
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const headerB64 = base64urlEncode(encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(header)));
  const payloadB64 = base64urlEncode(encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(payload)));
  const signingInput = `${headerB64}.${payloadB64}`;
  
  // Import the private key
  const privateKey = await importPrivateKey(serviceAccount.private_key);
  const signature = await crypto.subtle.sign(
    { name: "RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5" },
    privateKey,
    encoder.encode(signingInput)
  );
  
  const signatureB64 = base64urlEncode(new Uint8Array(signature));
  const jwt = `${headerB64}.${payloadB64}.${signatureB64}`;
  
  // Exchange JWT for access token
  const resp = await fetch("https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body: `grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer&assertion=${jwt}`,
  });
  
  const data = await resp.json();
  cachedToken = {
    token: data.access_token,
    expiresAt: Date.now() + (data.expires_in - 60) * 1000,
  };
  return cachedToken.token;
}
```

```typescript
async function importPrivateKey(pem: string): Promise<CryptoKey> {
  const pemContents = pem
    .replace(/-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----/g, "")
    .replace(/-----END PRIVATE KEY-----/g, "")
    .replace(/\s/g, "");
  
  const der = base64Decode(pemContents);
  
  return crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "pkcs8",
    der,
    { name: "RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5", hash: "SHA-256" },
    false,
    ["sign"]
  );
}
```

```typescript
function base64urlEncode(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  let binary = "";
  for (const byte of bytes) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(byte);

}
```

```typescript
function base64ToBuffer(base64: string): ArrayBuffer {
  const binary = atob(base64);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
    bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
  }
  return bytes.buffer;
}
```

```kotlin
    private suspend fun onFirebaseAuthSuccess(user: FirebaseUser) {
        val uid = user.uid
```

            "phone" to phone,
            "is_logged_in" to true,
            "auth_provider" to "PHONE",
        )

        if (!profileSnap.exists()) {
            profileData["name"] = "Parent"
            profileData["role"] = "PARENT"
            profileData["onboarding_complete"] = false
            profileData["dark_theme"] = false
            profileData["locale_code"] = "en"
            profileData["notifications_enabled"] = true
            profileData["camp_reminders_enabled"] = true
            profileData["consent_accepted"] = false
            profileData["consent_declined"] = false
            db.collection("profiles").document(uid).set(profileData).await()
        } else {
            val existingRole = profileSnap.getString("role") ?: "PARENT"
            profileData["role"] = existingRole
            db.collection("profiles").document(uid).set(profileData, SetOptions.merge()).await()
